page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column, with no margin notes. The top line is a continuation from the previous page. Below it are a rule heading, a paragraph of rules and examples, a second rule heading, a paragraph, a third rule heading, a list of conjunctions, and a catchword at the right foot.

main_text.p: timore domi meæ, quàm cum periculo domi alienæ, Cicero. Balbus à porta domum meam venit, Cicero.

Adverbia: ubi, nach dem. Cum, wenn / dieweil. Dum, bis. Donec, biß daß. Non, nit. Simulac, so bald. Simulatq;, so bald als. Postquam, nach dem. Quoad, so lange biß. Ut, wie. Quemadmodum, gleich wie. Utcunq;, Gott gebe wie. Sicut, als. Antequâ, ehe dann. Priusquam, ehe dann. Verbis primorum vel secundorum temporum adjunguntur. Ne, an, num, utrùm, was? Non, nicht? Adverbia interrogandi: ut, nach dem / Verbis primorum temporum tantùm conveniùt. Ne, an, num, utrùm, ob. Adverbia dubitandi. Utinam, wolt Gott. Quasi, gleich als. Ceu, gerad als. Tanquam, als ob. Perinde acsi, gleich als wenn. Haud secus ac si, nicht anderst als wen / Verbis secundorum temporum tantùm conveniunt. Ne pro Non, verbis secundorum temporum, aut verbis tertii futuri convenit: ut, Ne metuas. Ne feceris. Meretrix coronam auream ne habeto, Cicero.

Conjunctio, aut similes casus, aut similia tempora, aut Adverbia conjungit: ut, Nox & amor vinumque nihil moderabile suadent, Ovidius. Multa tulit fecitque puer, sudavit & alsit, Horatius. Scortari & potare & fores effringere est flagitium, Terentius. Impudenter & petulanter. Interdum casus vel tempus conjunctionem sequens cum priori discordat: ut, Fui Romæ & Thebis. Plenus vini & cerevisia. Revertimini ad me, & revertar ad vos, dicit Dominus exercituum.
Conjunctiones: Ni, wa[?] nicht. Nisi, wo nicht / es sey dann. Si, wann. Siquidem, sintemal. Etiamsi, wiewol.

page.notes: The catchword "Quòd," is taken from the foot of the page and kept out of the text. The reading "wa[?] nicht" in the list of conjunctions is uncertain; the printed gloss may be "wo nicht". The black-letter German glosses are marked with bl, and their exact letters are partly uncertain at this scan size. The question headings are set in italics and centred, and are given as level 2 because they are rule titles inside the division. The text is set in roman type with black-letter glosses and italic headings.
